title: Bar subplots draw date labels on inner shared-x axes
answers: Why do inner subplots show date tick labels in bar plots with shared x-axes?
How to hide date tick labels on inner subplots for bar plots with DatetimeIndex?
Where should dynamic date locators be installed in BarPlot to avoid redrawing shared-x labels?
body:
Symptom: In df.plot(kind="bar", subplots=True) with a DatetimeIndex or PeriodIndex, minor date tick labels appear on inner subplots instead of being hidden on shared x-axes.
Root cause: pandas/plotting/_matplotlib/core.py:BarPlot._post_plot_logic installed dynamic date locators after _adorn_subplots had already processed axes and hidden inner tick labels.
Fix pattern: Move format_dateaxis into pandas/plotting/_matplotlib/core.py:BarPlot._setup_date_axis before _adorn_subplots runs so locators are active before tick label suppression.
Constraints: Applies to BarPlot with dynamic date axes (self._use_dynamic_dateaxis); pandas/plotting/_matplotlib/core.py:BarPlot._post_plot_logic must still re-apply rot and fontsize because ax.set_xlim can introduce new minor ticks.
applies: pandas.plotting._matplotlib.core.BarPlot with DatetimeIndex or PeriodIndex and shared-x subplots
